# MEERO

- [Home](https://getmeero.com/): Find what is capping your time and revenue, then get an AI agent built around your business. Leave your first call with clear steps.
- [What an agent can do](https://getmeero.com/what-an-agent-can-do): Practical ways to organize recurring work in your business, plus the tasks a custom agent can handle around your existing tools.
- [AI agents for law firms: client intake and conflict checks](https://getmeero.com/what-an-agent-can-do/law-firms): Law firms can organize conflict-check preparation, consultation routing, and engagement letters while lawyers retain every acceptance decision.
- [How marketing agencies use AI agents for client reporting and scope control](https://getmeero.com/what-an-agent-can-do/marketing-agencies): Marketing agencies can assemble campaign reports, track creative approvals, and flag requests outside the signed scope before assigning work.
- [AI agents for bookkeeping firms: chasing month-end documents](https://getmeero.com/what-an-agent-can-do/bookkeeping-firms): Bookkeeping firms can organize missing receipts, statement requests, and close exceptions by entity so document gaps stay visible through month-end.
- [How real estate brokerages use AI agents for showings and seller updates](https://getmeero.com/what-an-agent-can-do/real-estate-brokerages): Real estate brokerages can coordinate showing access, gather buyer-agent feedback, and prepare seller updates from recorded listing activity.
- [AI agents for consulting firms: scoping calls to signed proposals](https://getmeero.com/what-an-agent-can-do/consulting-firms): Consulting firms can turn scoping notes into proposal drafts, reconcile statement-of-work versions, and check delivery capacity before kickoff.
- [How HVAC contractors use AI agents for quote follow-up and renewals](https://getmeero.com/what-an-agent-can-do/hvac-contractors): HVAC contractors can track post-visit quotes, renew service agreements, and coordinate parts and callbacks using current job-ticket details.
- [AI agents for commercial cleaning: shift coverage and site quality](https://getmeero.com/what-an-agent-can-do/commercial-cleaning): Commercial cleaning companies can verify shift coverage, organize quality inspections, and track site issues against each contract’s scope of work.
- [How med spas use AI agents to cut no-shows and rebook treatments](https://getmeero.com/what-an-agent-can-do/med-spas): Med spas can track appointment deposits, prepare approved aftercare check-ins, and coordinate package rebooking while providers handle clinical questions.
- [About Marwan Nassar](https://getmeero.com/about): Marwan Nassar operates Treehouse Music and builds custom agents himself, starting with the outreach work in his own business.
- [Privacy](https://getmeero.com/privacy): A plain-language account of this site’s optional Plausible analytics, Calendly booking calendar, and contact details, pending legal review.
